hero_eyebrow: Born in the Maloti Highlands, Lesotho
story_paragraph_1: Hope Hub started as one name, said differently. Ts'epo ."Hope is the fundamental backbone to life, take it away and even the strongest collapse. give a person nothing but hope, and somehow they build. It is the only thing we inherit that grows heavier and more necessary the longer we carry it and the only debt worth passing on to the next generation. Ka lehlohonolo its in my name" ~Ts'epo Mantutle
story_paragraph_2: Every mark we print — the map, the boy at Motoaitoai, the signature stitched below it — is a piece of that mountain sent out into the world, worn by whoever's ready to carry it.
hero_sub: Luxury streetwear cut for the mountain kingdom - heavy cotton, hand-finished pieces, made in small runs for those who carry it forward.
delivery_policy: Delivery: around town every Saturday via Maseru Jays. Collection: pick up any weekday at Foso Hardware, Ha Foso. Fit & exchanges: not quite right? Say so at the meetup or delivery and we'll sort a size swap on the spot.
